summary_bullets: Stall reports now distinguish unknown exit codes from captured numeric results and show sanitized bail reasons.
Step 2 hard-bail reasons now survive into stall recovery classification without widening the public bail-reason enum.
Regression coverage preserves argv bail-reason classifier evidence while pinning the new report fields.
commit_message:
Surface sanitized stall bail reasons

Render missing or malformed stall exit codes as unknown, add the sanitized Bail reason row to public stall reports, and keep numeric exit codes unchanged. Mirror Step 2 hard-bail reasons into the in-memory bail handoff and keep --bail-reason as classifier evidence for transient and dispatch failure routing.
